requirements.summary: Replace user-facing “Marketplace” branding with “Meyouu” across document title, header logo alt text, footer copyright, and browse/home hero banner alt text and headings.
acceptanceCriteria: Header branding uses “Meyouu” (e.g., logo alt text updated from “Marketplace” to “Meyouu”).
Footer copyright line shows “Meyouu” instead of “Marketplace”.
Browse/home page hero/banner image alt text and the main page heading/subheading reflect the “Meyouu” brand name.

No remaining user-facing occurrences of the old app name “Marketplace” used as the product/brand name (excluding generic uses of the word marketplace in descriptive sentences, if any are intentionally kept).

file_operations.description: Update the HTML <title> to display “Meyouu” in the browser tab (remove the old “Marketplace” product branding from the title).
Update the header’s branding/logo alt text from “Marketplace” to “Meyouu” (keep the existing logo image path unchanged unless otherwise required).
Update the footer copyright line to display “Meyouu” instead of “Marketplace”, ensuring only user-visible brand name text changes.
Update the browse/home hero/banner image alt text and the main heading/subheading so they reflect the “Meyouu” brand name (remove user-facing “Marketplace” as the product/brand name).
